name: io.github.franprzdev/scopeprofit
title: ScopeProfit
description: MCP server that turns client requests into a clear scope document and a quote with your own rates. 20 tools for scoping, approval and quoting, with PDF/Word exports. Connect ChatGPT, Claude or any MCP client to the hosted instance, or self-host with Docker Compose.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key (sp_live_...) issued by the installation operator. ChatGPT and Claude connectors can instead use the built-in OAuth 2.1 flow (dynamic client registration + PKCE).
